summary: One-frame result of reporting a mod to mod.io (client only, registry total 8). ls::PublishingSystem (per-frame update bg3.exe+0x3BDE2A0; Toolkit GameEngine.dll ls::PublishingSystem::Process*Requests) creates it on a new entity from a request queued by the matching HandleUGC... callback of the mod.io back-end; the same frame also gets a UGCRequestResultOneFrameComponent with the net::UGCResult and request Guid. Request queue filled by HandleUGCItemReported(unsigned __int64, net::UGCResult); drained by bg3.exe+0x3BDF3C0.

fields.name: ModId
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x3BE1860 allocates 8 bytes and zeroes them; bg3.exe+0x3BDF3C0 stores the request's first qword (the unsigned __int64 mod id of HandleUGCItemReported; request stride 0x40: id +0, UGCResult +8, Guid +0x30) into +0. Toolkit GameEngine.dll ProcessUGCItemReportedRequests does the same (`*comp = *request`).
